```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Peer submits input] --> B{PROVIDE or ASSAY?}

    B -->|Received document| C[ASSAY]

    C1 --> C2[Name evaporated content]

    C3 --> C4[Report ratio, erosion, and rough edge]
    C4 --> C5[Return finding]
    C5 --> C6["This is a finding, not a draft."]
    C6 --> Z[Stop]

    B -->|Draft prompt or task| D[PROVIDE]

    D2 --> D1

    E --> E1{Floor passes?}

    E2 --> E
    E1 -->|No, 4 or more gaps| E3[Ask three largest gaps]
    E3 --> E4[Assume the remaining gaps]
    E4 --> E
    E1 -->|Yes| F[Compress the prompt]
    F --> F1{Cut removed specification?}
    F1 -->|Yes| F2[Name decorative or destructive cut]
    F2 --> F
    F1 -->|No| F3{Two consecutive Cut: nothing.?}
    F3 -->|No| F4{Floor still passes?}
    F4 -->|No| F5[Return the last passing version]
    F5 --> G[Output the contract]
    F4 -->|Yes| F
    F3 -->|Yes| G
    G --> H["Freeze this contract and execute, or keep negotiating?"]
    H -->|Keep negotiating| F
    H -->|Freeze, execute, or run it from named human signer| I{Execution tools available?}
    I -->|No| J[Gate stays closed]
    I -->|Yes| K["Contract frozen. Executing."]
    K --> L{Result}
    L -->|Success| M[Done]
    L -->|Floor item fails| N[Failed on item. Contract reopened.]
    N --> F
```
